description: Source code for the 'Tax Withholding Category' document in ERPNext, including validation, retrieval, and calculation functions related to tax withholding categories, rates, and associated invoices.

classes.name: TaxWithholdingCategory
classes.description: Represents a tax withholding category with validation for date overlaps, account duplicates, and threshold logic.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the tax withholding category, including date ranges, accounts, and thresholds.

methods.name: validate_dates
methods.description: Checks for overlapping date ranges in rates.

methods.name: validate_accounts
methods.description: Ensures no duplicate accounts are added.

methods.name: validate_thresholds
methods.description: Validates that thresholds are logically consistent.

methods.name: get_party_details
methods.description: Determines party type and party name based on invoice doctype.

methods.name: get_party_tax_withholding_details
methods.description: Retrieves tax withholding details for a party, including category and PAN.

methods.name: get_tax_withholding_details
methods.description: Fetches tax withholding details for a category and company at a specific date.

methods.name: get_tax_withholding_rates
methods.description: Finds the applicable rate for a given date.

methods.name: get_tax_row_for_tcs
methods.description: Constructs a tax row for TCS calculations.

methods.name: get_tax_row_for_tds
methods.description: Constructs a tax row for TDS calculations.

methods.name: get_lower_deduction_certificate
methods.description: Retrieves a valid lower deduction certificate based on PAN and date range.

methods.name: get_tax_amount
methods.description: Calculates the tax amount, including deductions, thresholds, and certificates.

methods.name: get_invoice_vouchers
methods.description: Fetches invoice and journal entry vouchers for tax calculations.

methods.name: get_advance_vouchers
methods.description: Fetches advance vouchers for tax calculations.

methods.name: get_taxes_deducted_on_advances_allocated
methods.description: Retrieves taxes allocated on advances.

methods.name: get_deducted_tax
methods.description: Calculates total deducted tax on vouchers.

methods.name: get_tds_amount
methods.description: Calculates TDS amount considering thresholds and certificates.

methods.name: get_tcs_amount
methods.description: Calculates TCS amount based on invoice and threshold.

methods.name: get_invoice_total_without_tcs
methods.description: Calculates invoice total excluding TCS.

methods.name: get_tds_amount_from_ldc
methods.description: Calculates TDS amount from a lower deduction certificate.

methods.name: get_debit_note_amount
methods.description: Calculates total debit note amount for suppliers.

methods.name: get_ltds_amount
methods.description: Calculates limited TDS amount based on certificate limit.

methods.name: is_valid_certificate
methods.description: Checks if a certificate is valid for a given date and amount.
